title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Chair
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·情感与情绪）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·情感与情绪）　|　核心词汇：ease　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ease 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my grandmother ① found an ease that no doctor in the house would have granted, and she said the finding was the whole of the winter. The ② ease, meaning the comfort and not the relief, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an ease, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left ungranted.

Every ③ ease in that house had the same short chair at the end of it, and the ④ ease at the end, meaning the one they kept for the afternoon and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An ease, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to grant; my grandmother said the granting is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ease was the whole of the story, meaning the relief and not the comfort. The ⑥ ease, meaning the relief and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody asks for and nobody admits; ease, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a comfort and a relief. He said the relief is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ ease had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ ease of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and fourteen winters of granting; ease, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to grant. She said the granting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ease I remember is the one named in the diary, which faded in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the house. An ⑩ ease, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being granted; every ease, she said, is a relief that has agreed to look like a comfort. She said the relief was the honest half.

answers.why: find an ease 意为“得到一份安适”，1953 年祖母得到了一份屋子里没有一位医生肯给她的安适。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，指那份安适本身而不是缓解，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，指那座房子里的每一份安适，每一份到头都有同一把小小的椅子。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，指留给午后的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ease 意为“缓解、减轻”，指故事里人人都求却无人承认的那样东西，叔叔说这份缓解就是那个故事的全部。
ease 意为“缓解”，指人人都求却无人承认的那种东西而不是那份安适，是故事里人人都求、却无人承认的东西。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，指日记里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1962 年这份安适成了日记里的一行。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，祖母一月写道，整件事的安适之事是一座房子和十四个冬天的给予。
ease 意为“安适、自在”，我记得的是日记里记下的那一份，1974 年淡去了，至今仍被说成屋子里最安静的一份。
ease 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一份安适是唯一会因为被好好给予而变得更好的东西。
